findings.label: hasAutoOpenedRef declared after its useEffect
findings.detail: The useRef(false) declaration appears after both useEffect calls that reference it. Safe at runtime but triggers ESLint no-use-before-define and obscures data flow. Move it before the first effect that uses it.

findings.label: Auto-open skips directory-only repo roots
findings.detail: All four arms of the auto-open selection filter f.type === 'file'. Monorepos or repos whose root is all directories (packages/, apps/, src/) will never auto-open a file, leaving the editor blank. Extend the search into dirContents or pre-expand the first directory.

findings.label: selectedFile guard races on repo switch
findings.detail: The auto-open effect checks '|| selectedFile' and exits if it is non-null. On repo switch the previous file is not cleared when fetchRepoContent('') is called, so the guard fires and the new repo never gets an auto-opened file. Fix by adding setSelectedFile(null) at the top of fetchRepoContent when path === ''.

findings.label: Build result unverifiable
findings.detail: No tsc --noEmit or npm run build output was provided. The changes appear syntactically consistent but TypeScript errors cannot be ruled out without the actual compiler output.
